objections.objection: Spec §5.6 point 2 explicitly lists 'any expand/collapse affordance' as in-scope, but BA moved the truncateLines + more-lines indicator to R7 Could Have. BashView.tsx lines 14-19 + 77-79 show the existing inline truncation pattern (MAX_PREVIEW_LINES=2, '+N more lines'). If the user sees an inline Codex bash card with unbounded output while the Claude Code card shows '+N more lines', the redesign is NOT complete.
objections.recommendation: Upgrade R7 (truncateLines) from Could Have to Must Have, OR document explicitly in the spec that Codex bash branch uses CommandView (which does not truncate) while Claude Code BashView truncates — and justify the asymmetry.

objections.objection: Spec §5.6 includes 'header' in scope, but BA's analysis stays within CodexBashView body. The popup header (tool name chip, icon, status) is rendered elsewhere (ToolView/ToolFullView). BA did verify ToolView.tsx:168-174 icon special-case is still valid, but did not verify the Codex popup HEADER as a whole matches Claude Code popup header.
objections.recommendation: Either (a) audit ToolFullView's rendering for CodexBash vs Bash and confirm header parity, or (b) document in the spec that header parity is already correct and R6 (icon special-case review) is the only header concern.

objections.objection: User's verbatim complaint '打开右侧弹窗' wording from §5.3 mentions the right-side popup. §5.6's user phrase 'codex窗口' (codex window) + reference screenshot could be the sidebar popup. SidebarBashView already routes CodexBash (verified). This means the §5.6 work may largely be delivered by the §5.3 fix to CommandView — BA's 3 gaps are valid for the inline card only. If user's screenshot is the sidebar popup specifically, BA needs to also reference the §5.3 fix in CommandView as part of §5.6 completion.
objections.recommendation: Clarify with the user whether §5.6 refers to the inline card or the right-side popup (or both). BA's current spec handles both correctly if §5.3 fix lands: inline via this spec, sidebar via §5.3's CommandView fix.

summary: BA spec for §5.6 is technically sound and evidence-accurate. All 3 concrete gaps cited (read/write branches no ScrollView, bash branch no outer ScrollView, container surfaceHigh vs terminal.background) are verified line-for-line in the source. Git commit timeline (cdbcb9ab 2025-09-03 → 1c85cc62 2026-03-21) is accurate. All 8 referenced files exist. Two minor scope warnings: (1) expand/collapse affordance (truncateLines from BashView) was downgraded to Could Have despite being explicitly in spec §5.6 scope; (2) 'header' scope is implicit, not audited — BA focused on inline body. Both warnings are non-blocking — dev can ship per current spec and QA can verify header parity separately. Verdict: pass_with_warnings.
